WHOLE POSITIONS
DEFENDER'S POSITION: "Jesus shared human flesh and blood and took hold of Abraham's seed; the promised seed came from David's body; Joseph is named in the household and belongs to David's line; the Holy Ghost marks covenant origin; and Joseph begat Jesus by knowing Mary during the espousal." -- RESTS ON: D1 [L1] Hebrews 2:14, 16 (margin), [L3] John 1:14; D2 [L1] 2 Samuel 7:12, [L3] Acts 2:30 and Romans 1:3; D3 [L1] Luke 2:48 and Matthew 1:20, [L3] John 6:42, Luke 4:22, John 1:45 and Numbers 1:2; D4 [L1] Matthew 1:20 and Luke 1:35, [L3] Acts 1:8, Matthew 17:5 and 1 Chronicles 28:6; D5 [L1] Matthew 1:18–20, 24–25, [L3] Genesis 4:1 and 1 Samuel 1:19.
CHALLENGER'S POSITION: "Jesus had no human biological father: Mary bore him, the Holy Ghost was the source of the conception, and Joseph was Mary's husband and the child's father in the household." -- RESTS ON: C1 [L1] Luke 1:34–35 and Matthew 1:20, [L3] Matthew 1:16, 23, Isaiah 7:14 and Luke 3:23, with Romans 1:3 and Acts 2:30 for descent; C2 [L1] Matthew 1:18, [L3] Matthew 1:19–20, 24–25, Deuteronomy 22:23–24 and 1 Corinthians 7:5; C3 [L1] Matthew 1:19–20, [L3] 1 Chronicles 28:6 and 2 Samuel 7:14; C4 [L1] Luke 1:31–35, [L3] Matthew 1:20, Acts 1:8 and Matthew 17:5.
WHICH HOLDS: CHALLENGER -- DECIDES [L4]: "Davidic descent and Joseph's household place agree with the accounts, but the reply to Mary and the reason given to Joseph identify the Holy Ghost as the source of the conception, not merely as the giver of an honour after a human begetting." -- FROM: [L1] Luke 1:34–35 and [L3] Matthew 1:18, 20, 23, read with [L3] Romans 1:3, Acts 2:30 and Luke 2:48 -- MEETS: [CR1] "of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne" -- WHY IT FAILS: Acts 2:30 establishes bodily descent; as [DR3] shows with Genesis 35:11, descent language can span generations, while Matthew 1:20 and Luke 1:34–35 address this conception itself.
BROKEN (Commitment 7). [L1] Luke 1:34–35 makes the action of the Holy Ghost the answer to Mary's question, and [L3] Matthew 1:20 gives that action its bearing on what is conceived. [L4] The household titles and the pattern of knowing in Genesis 4:1 do not answer the timing press when read with Matthew 1:18 and its exhibited cross-references.
